shots.text: At Reedhaven the Saltmother's column of seawater burst on the ice. She had been the high priestess of the Tidefolk. When she fell, we found an order sewn into her robes, sending her to the Rift to study the Gate. It was sealed with Cassivane's seal.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: The Saltmother's water-column bursting apart on the ice, fish and drowned lanterns scattering. On the ice beside her, an oilskin packet split open: an order stamped with the Lord Marshal's red seal.

shots.text: In the middle of the flooded reeds stood a tower of ice the sea had not broken. Inside it was Mirelle, a blind Tidefolk seer who reads the future in ice. She had kept forty children alive in there.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A tower of ice standing in black floodwater; inside, Mirelle, small, pearls sewn on everything, blind eyes glowing teal, holding an ice staff, children huddled behind her.

shots.text: You're late. Only a little. I saw that too.
shots.speaker: mirelle
shots.art_note: Mirelle stepping out onto the frost, barefoot. Joins as a hero.
